title: 一般过去时（测试样例）
summary: 能用一般过去时讲清楚一件已经结束的事，口语 Part 2 讲经历时不再漏掉 -ed。

sections.heading: 什么时候用
sections.body:
动作**在过去某个时间点已经结束**，而且和现在没有直接联系时，用一般过去时。

常和 yesterday、last week、in 2019、two days ago 这类时间词一起出现。

examples.en: I visited my grandparents last weekend.
examples.cn: 我上周末去看了祖父母。
examples.note: last weekend 是明确的过去时间

sections.heading: 规则变化与常见不规则动词
sections.body:
规则动词加 **-ed**；以 e 结尾只加 -d；辅音加 y 结尾改 y 为 i 再加 -ed。

不规则动词要单独记，下表是口语里最常用的几个。

sections.heading: 否定和疑问
sections.body: 否定和疑问借助 **did**，后面的动词回到原形。

examples.note: did 之后用 finish，不用 finished

examples.en:
Q: Did you go anywhere last weekend?
A: Yes, I went to Bath with my cousin.
examples.cn:
问：你上周末去哪儿了吗？
答：去了，我和表哥去了巴斯。
examples.note: 口语 Part 1 问答：问句用 did + 原形，回答用过去式

pitfalls.wrong: I go to the park yesterday.
pitfalls.right: I went to the park yesterday.
pitfalls.why: 中文动词没有时态变化，容易忘记把动词改成过去式。
did 已经表示过去，后面的动词要用原形。
buy 是不规则动词，过去式是 bought。

exercises.q: We ___ a great time at the festival last summer.
exercises.explain: last summer 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时 had。
take 是不规则动词，过去式是 took。

exercises.q: Did she called you last night?
answer: Did she call you last night?
exercises.explain: did 之后动词用原形 call。

exercises.q: They ___ (not / visit) the museum because it was closed.
exercises.explain: 否定用 didn't / did not 加动词原形，两种写法都可以。

title: 定语从句写长句（测试样例）
summary: 能用 which / who / where 把两句短句合成一句，写作 Task 2 里体现句式多样性。

sections.heading: 限制性与非限制性
sections.body: 限制性定语从句**缩小**先行词的范围，不加逗号；非限制性定语从句只是**补充说明**，前后用逗号隔开，而且不能用 that。

examples.en: Students who live on campus save a lot of travelling time.
examples.cn: 住在校内的学生能省下很多通勤时间。

examples.en: Online courses, which are often cheaper, attract many adult learners.
examples.cn: 网课通常更便宜，吸引了很多成年学习者。
examples.note: 非限制性从句用逗号隔开，用 which 不用 that

examples.en:
Before: Some students live on campus. They save a lot of time.
After: Students who live on campus save a lot of time.
examples.cn: 改写前是两个短句，改写后用 who 合成一句。

sections.heading: 关系词怎么选
sections.body: 先看先行词是人、物还是地点，再看关系词在从句里做什么成分。

head: 先行词
关系词
例句
rows: People who exercise regularly sleep better.
The policy that the council introduced has failed.
Cities where public transport is free have less traffic.

pitfalls.wrong: The book which I bought it is useful.
pitfalls.right: The book which I bought is useful.
pitfalls.why: which 已经代替 it 做 bought 的宾语，不能再重复 it。

pitfalls.wrong: My sister, that lives in York, is a nurse.
pitfalls.right: My sister, who lives in York, is a nurse.
pitfalls.why: 非限制性定语从句不能用 that。

pitfalls.wrong: This is the town which I grew up.
pitfalls.right: This is the town where I grew up.
pitfalls.why: grow up 是不及物动词，地点要用 where（或 in which）。

exercises.q: London, ___ is the capital of the UK, has a population of about nine million.
exercises.explain: 逗号隔开的非限制性从句，指物用 which。

exercises.q: The village ___ my father was born has changed a lot.
exercises.explain: 先行词是地点，从句缺地点状语，用 where 或 in which。

exercises.q: The scientist which won the prize is from Wales.
answer: The scientist who won the prize is from Wales.
The scientist that won the prize is from Wales.
exercises.explain: 先行词是人，用 who 或 that。
